core_files.summary: Thin CLI wrapper that delegates to video_director_v3.pipeline.pipeline_runner.main.

Runs hyperframes_preview and render_mp4 modes. Preview stages read script, build narration, run TTS, build storyboard, build scene_pack, create visual/caption beats, build Studio native project, generate reports, and gate approval.
Centralizes output and test_output project directories. Do not scatter generated artifacts elsewhere.
Turns raw Chinese script into structured spoken sentences and narration outputs.
Builds motion/storyboard scenes from narration, platform profile, audio timing, and design variance.
Builds scene_pack and visual strategy fields used by render templates and quality gates.
Validates contract scenes and fallback behavior before templates render.
Runs selected TTS mode and produces real audio duration for the timeline.
Generates caption beats aligned to narration/audio timing. Caption beats should not be treated as visual scenes.
Plans visual beat metadata for preview timing and transitions.
Builds semantic transitions / transition map between storyboard scenes.
Authoritative builder for HyperFrames Studio Native Preview project. Creates hyperframes_timeline/index.html, data JSON, meta, audio asset, scene/caption clips, and review frames.
Dispatches visual templates and strategy skeletons into HTML scene bodies. Key location for card page rendering and HUD visual structures.
Captures review frames/contact sheet for human visual inspection before MP4.
Renders MP4 after explicit approval; not part of intermediate preview review.
Quality checks for preview/render outputs. Should block bad preview states before approval.

protected_rules: Do not create a parallel pipeline.
Do not replace HyperFrames Studio Native Preview as the main review path.
Do not use combined/index.html, file://, Remotion, CapCut, or custom GSAP pages as mainline.
Do not run render_mp4 before explicit human approval.
Do not commit outputs/, renders/, contact-sheet.jpg, or final_video.mp4.

comparison_hint_for_v3_repair.observed_strength: This repo keeps the generation path simpler: script/narration/storyboard/scene_pack feed deterministic HyperFrames card templates, which can produce normal card pages when content is already compact and scene count is controlled.
use_for_v3: Prefer simple card-page rendering first, then add animation.
Keep caption beats separate from visual scenes.
Do not expose internal fields such as layout_family or visual_object as user-visible copy.
Route each card through a concise headline/support copy contract before rendering.
Use review frames as the visual authority, not only JSON quality scores.
